description.text: Winter courses generally starts in the beginning of January and ends at the beginning of February. (If you cannot participate the course from the beginning, you may apply to join a class in the middle between this period unless you are a complete beginner of the Chinese language.) Tuition Fee: * Tuition Fee for the Mini-classes: 1 (student) on 1 (teacher) class; RMB80 (about $11) /per class hour; 2 on 1 class; RMB70 (about $10) /per class hour/per student; 3 on 1 class; RMB50 (about $7) /per class hour/per student; 4 on 1 class; RMB40 (about $5.7) /per class hour/per student; 5 on 1 class; RMB35 (about $5) /per class hour/per student. (2-4 class hours a day, 5 days a week. For 2/3/4/5 on 1 class.) * Tuition Fee for the Regular Classes: 2-weeks: RMB 615 per week 3-weeks: RMB 547 per week 4-weeks: RMB 513 per week 5-weeks: RMB 492 per week 6-weeks: RMB 479 per week 7-weeks: RMB 469 per week 8-weeks: RMB 462 per week 9-weeks: RMB 456 per week (4 class hours a day, 5 days a week.) hours a day, 5 days a week. For 2/3/4/5 on 1 class.) iii. Textbooks: about RMB 100 (about $15) iv. Accommodation Fee: —Double Room: at Hui Xian Yuan: RMB 40 (about $5.8) / per day at International Exchange Center: RMB 60 (about $8.6) / per day (Internet connection free) —Single Room: at Student Residential Quarters: RMB 50 (about $7.2) / per day at Hui Xian Yuan: RMB 80 (about $11.5) / per day at International Exchange Center: RMB120 (about $17.2)/per day (Internet connection free) If you pay the accommodation fee by lump sum (i.e. pay the accommodation fee all at once) for 30 days or more when you check in, there will be a deduction of RMB 5 to RMB 10 per day according to different types of room.) Notes: * The numbers of US dollars in the brackets are for your reference, and you may check on the Internet for current exchange rate. * The International Student Dormitory is open to service for 24 hours a day and you may check in anytime when you arrive on campus. * The office hour of the International Student Office is from 8:30am to 5:00pm, Monday to Friday. After you have settled down at the International Student Dormitory, you may come to the Office for registration.

duration.text: The Winter Course at Tianjin University of Technology is a 1 Week long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 85 USD/per week ￥ 615 CNY/per week

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1.Graduation from high school (or the equivalent) 2.18 to 60 years of age
